description: Agent-triggered interactive git/jj operations left a rogue zile spinning on a core until killed. Two layers: (1) unconditional tty guard on the zile package itself (overlays/pkg/zile.nix), covering every pkgs.zile consumer; (2) local.no-editor shim wired into programs.claude-code.settings.env for EDITOR/VISUAL/GIT_EDITOR/GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR/JJ_EDITOR/SUDO_EDITOR plus cat pagers, so the failure is immediate and actionable.

comments.text: Review round 1 (tuicr): extracted the env map into an agent-agnostic home-modules/agent-env.nix (programs.agentEnv.variables + .markers), consumed by claude's settings.env and by a fish/bash init hook keyed on markers. Markers: OMPCODE (oh-my-pi), CLAUDECODE + AI_AGENT (claude-code). agy is not covered by a declarative seat because it rewrites its own settings.json at runtime; it is covered by the shell hook once its marker var is known, and by the tty guard unconditionally today.

title: Make interactive editors impossible in agent sessions
